y-m-14-05.title: Ingabe 'uma kunesilinganiso solayini, kunesilinganiso sephoyinti' kuyiqiniso? Ukuhlola ngesibonelo esiphikisayo
y-m-14-05.topic: Izibalo ezinesilinganiso solayini nesilinganiso sephoyinti: izibonelo eziphikisayo
y-m-14-05.goal: Hlola, ngokugoqa nangokujikeleza, ukuthi isiphetho esijwayelekile mayelana nezibalo ezinesilinganiso solayini nesilinganiso sephoyinti (isitatimende sesibili) sihlala singamandla yini, futhi unikeze uchaze isibonelo esiphikisayo wena.
y-m-14-05.material: U-Haram uthe, “Uma isibalo sinesilinganiso solayini, sinesilinganiso sephoyinti futhi.” Isibalo esinesilinganiso solayini yisibalo esingena ngqo phezu kwaso uma sigoqwe ngelayini, futhi isibalo esinesilinganiso sephoyinti yisibalo esingena ngqo phezu kwesibalo sokuqala uma sijikelezwa ngengxenye yokujika (180°) ezungeze iphoyinti. Azikho izithombe, ngakho cabanga ngezibalo ngamagama azo. Cabanga ngesikwele esinde njengesingesona isikwele, nge-parallelogram njengeyingesona isikwele esinde noma i-rhombus.
y-m-14-05.thinking.1: Ukuhlukanisa izindlela ezimbili zokuhlola, ukugoqa nokujikeleza ngengxenye yokujika
y-m-14-05.thinking.2: Ukwenza isibonelo sakho esiphikisayo kusitatimende esingagcini
y-m-14-05.prereq.0: Isibalo esinesilinganiso solayini: isibalo esingena ngqo phezu kwaso uma sigoqwe ngelayini
y-m-14-05.prereq.1: Isibalo esinesilinganiso sephoyinti: isibalo esingena ngqo phezu kwesibalo sokuqala uma sijikelezwa ngengxenye yokujika (180°) ezungeze iphoyinti
y-m-14-05.s.s1.prompt: Phakathi kwezibalo ezingezansi, khetha zonke izibalo ezikhombisa ukuthi isitatimende sika-Haram 'uma isibalo sinesilinganiso solayini, sinesilinganiso sephoyinti futhi' asiyona iqiniso.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kusibalo ngasinye, bhala ethebuleni elinamakholomu amabili 'Ingabe likhona ilayini ongagoqa ngalo ukuze lingene?' no-'Ingabe lingena uma lijikelezwa ngengxenye yokujika?'
y-m-14-05.s.s1.hint.1: Sho ukuthi iyiphi inhlanganisela yamabhokisi ethebuleni oyidingayo ukuze uphule isitatimende sika-Haram.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kukhetha kuhlole kokubili ukuthi kuyangena uma kugoqiwe nokuthi kuyangena uma kujikelezwa ngengxenye yokujika.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.b: Isikwele esinde singena kokubili uma sigoqiwe nalapho sijikelezwa, ngakho asiphikisani nesitatimende sika-Haram. Ukukhombisa ukuthi isitatimende asilungile, udinga isibalo esinesilinganiso solayini kodwa esingenaso isilinganiso sephoyinti.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.c: I-parallelogram ayinalo ilayini ongagoqa ngalo ukuze ingene. Ukuhlola isitatimende sika-Haram, isibalo kumele kuqala sibe nesilinganiso solayini.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu kukhetha kuhlole kokubili ilayini eliyenza ingene uma igoqiwe nokuthi ingena yini uma ijikelezwa.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.e: I-rhombus ingena kokubili uma igoqiwe nalapho ijikelezwa, ngakho ayiphikisani nesitatimende sika-Haram.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.explain: Isibonelo esiphikisayo yisibalo 'esinesilinganiso solayini kodwa singenaso isilinganiso sephoyinti'. Unxantathu onezinhlangothi ezilinganayo ne-pentagon evamile banamalayini abangena ngawo uma bagoqiwe, kodwa abangeni ngesimo sokuqala uma bejikelezwa ngengxenye yokujika. Isikwele esinde ne-rhombus bangena ngazo zombili izindlela, futhi i-parallelogram inesilinganiso sephoyinti kodwa ayinaso isilinganiso solayini, ngakho ayikwazi ukuba yisibonelo esiphikisayo kuleli tatimende.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.prompt: Kulokhu u-Haram uthe okuphambene. “Uma isibalo sinesilinganiso sephoyinti, sinesilinganiso solayini futhi.” I-parallelogram engesona isikwele esinde noma i-rhombus ingena esibalweni sokuqala uma ijikelezwa ngengxenye yokujika ezungeze iphoyinti. Ungasahlulela kanjani isitatimende sesibili sika-Haram usebenzisa le parallelogram?
y-m-14-05.s.s2.hint.0: Linga ukunquma i-parallelogram ephepheni bese ubona ukuthi ikhona yini indlela yokuyigoqa ukuze izinhlangothi zombili zingene.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.hint.1: Sho ukuthi iyiphi indlela yesimo esinganele ukukhombisa ukuthi isitatimende 'siyiqiniso njalo' asilungile.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.o.a: Uma uphendulela i-parallelogram ingxenye yesigamu sokujika, ihlangana nesimo sokuqala, ngakho kuyisibonelo esikhombisa ukuthi isitatimende esithi 'uma inobuncane bephoyinti, inobuncane bomugqa' silungile
y-m-14-05.s.s2.r.a: Uhlole kuphela ukuthi inobuncane bephoyinti, awuhlolanga ukuthi inobuncane bomugqa yini. Ukuze isitatimende silunge, kufanele ibe nobuncane bomugqa nayo.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.o.b: Isimo esisodwa asikwazi ukufakazela ukuthi isitatimende siphutha, ngakho kufanele sinqume ngemva kokubheka ezinye izimo ezimbalwa ezifanayo
y-m-14-05.s.s2.r.b: Ushiyile ukuthi igama elithi 'njalo' lingaphulwa ngisho nasisibonelo esisodwa.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.o.c: I-parallelogram ayinawo umugqa owenza uhhafu ahlangane uma kugoqwa, ngakho lesi simo esisodwa sikhombisa ukuthi isitatimende siphutha
y-m-14-05.s.s2.r.c: Lesi sinqumo sixhumanisa indlela yokuhlola nesiphetho.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.o.d: Ukuthi ihlangana uma kugoqwa nokuthi ihlangana uma iphendulwa kubheka isici esifanayo, ngakho ukuhlola okukodwa kwanele
y-m-14-05.s.s2.r.d: Ukuhlola okubili kubheka izici ezihlukile. Ezinye izimo zinaso esisodwa kuphela.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.explain: Ukuze 'uma isimo sinobuncane bephoyinti, sinobuncane bomugqa' kube yiqiniso njalo, zonke izimo ezinobuncane bephoyinti kufanele zibe nomugqa okufanela ngawo uma kugoqwa. I-parallelogram engeyona unxande noma i-rhombus ayinawo umugqa ofanela ngawo uma kugoqwa, ngakho iyisibonelo esiphikisayo esinobuncane bephoyinti kodwa singenabo bomugqa. Isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo sanele ukuphula igama elithi 'njalo'.
y-m-14-05.s.s3.prompt: Nikeza isimo esisodwa, esingekho phakathi kwezinketho ezingenhla, esinobuncane bomugqa kodwa singenabo bephoyinti. Bhala ukuthi sibukeka kanjani uma sigoqwa nokuthi sibukeka kanjani uma siphendulwa ngesigamu sokujika, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani leso simo siyisibonelo esiphikisayo sesitatimende sokuqala sikaHaram.

y-m-14-05.s.s3.hint.1: Landela ukuthi ingxenye ebise ngaphezulu iya kuphi uma uphendula leso simo ngesigamu sokujika.

Kodwa uma uphendulwa ngesigamu sokujika ikhona liya ezansi futhi akufaneli nesimo sokuqala, ngakho awunabo ubuncane bephoyinti.

y-m-14-06.title: Zingaki izinhlobo zezakhiwo zenhlaka yebhokisi elinxande ongazenza ngocingo olungu-60 cm?
y-m-14-06.topic: Ibhokisi elinxande: isamba sobude bemiphetho nokuklama isimo
y-m-14-06.goal: Veza umbandela wesamba sobude bemiphetho njengesibalo, uthole ngaphandle kokushiya zonke izakhiwo zenhlaka yebhokisi elinxande ezifeza imibandela eminingana, bese uchaza ukuthi kungenzeka ingabikho inhlaka uma imibandela ishintsha.
y-m-14-06.material: Ufuna ukusebenzisa wonke ucingo olungu-60 cm, ungashiyi lutho, ukwenza inhlaka (isakhiwo esingenayo ubuso) eyenziwe kuphela ngemiphetho yebhokisi elinxande. Umphetho omude kakhulu wenhlaka kufanele ube ngu-9 cm noma ngaphezulu, futhi umphetho omfushane kakhulu kufanele ube ngu-2 cm noma ngaphezulu.

y-m-14-02.title: Sidingani ukwazi ukuze sinqume indawo yephepha le-kite eyodwa?
y-m-14-02.topic: Indawo ye-rhombus: ulwazi oludingekayo ukunquma indawo
y-m-14-02.goal: Hlunga ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi oluyanela nolungenele ukunquma indawo ye-rhombus, klama ama-rhombus ahlukene anendawo efanayo, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani ubude bohlangothi kuphela bungakunquli indawo.
y-m-14-02.material: Indawo yokusebenzela yenza ama-kite ephepha ngesimo se-rhombus. I-rhombus iyisimo esinezinhlangothi ezine izinhlangothi zaso zonke ezine zinobude obufanayo. I-kite ngayinye ifika nolwazi oluhlukile, futhi sifuna ukuthola ukuthi ulwazi olwalo kuphela lunquma yini, njengenani elilodwa, indawo yephepha elisetshenziselwa ukwenza i-kite eyodwa. Wonke ubude ungu-cm, futhi i-kite icatshangwa njengeshidi elilodwa eliyisicaba lephepha. Izingcezu zolwazi ezingezansi zimayelana nama-kite ahlukene.
y-m-14-02.thinking.1: Ukucabanga ukuthi yini ehluka ngezindlela eziningi ngenxa yolwazi olushodayo
y-m-14-02.prereq.0: Ukwazi ukuthi i-rhombus iyisimo esinezinhlangothi ezine izinhlangothi zaso zonke ezine zinobude obufanayo
y-m-14-02.prereq.1: Ukwazi ama-diagonal e-rhombus nesisekelo nobude be-parallelogram

y-m-14-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kucezu ngalunye lolwazi, hlola ukuthi ungacabanga yini i-rhombus eyanelisa ncamashi kodwa inendawo ehlukile.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.hint.1: Thatha uhlaka lwe-rhombus olwenziwe ngokuxhuma izinti ezine bese ulucindezela lube yisicaba ohlangothini olulodwa. Bona ukuthi yini ishintsha nokuthi yini ihlala injalo.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.o.a: Zonke izinhlangothi ezine zingu-30 cm, ngakho umjikelezo ungu-120 cm
y-m-14-02.s.s1.r.a: Noma ubude bezinhlangothi bufana, indawo iyashintsha lapho i-rhombus icindezelwa ibe yisicaba noma imiswa. Ubude bohlangothi abunqumi ukuthi ithambekela kangakanani.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.o.b: Uhlangothi olulodwa lungu-20 cm, futhi ubude kuleso hlangothi bungu-18 cm
y-m-14-02.s.s1.r.b: Lombono ubona i-rhombus njenge-parallelogram enesisekelo nobude, ngakho indawo yayo ingenqunywa.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.r.c: Ngisho noma i-diagonal eyodwa ifana, indawo iyashintsha uma enye i-diagonal iba mide noma imfushane.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.o.d: Ubude bama-diagonal amabili bungu-40 cm no-24 cm

y-m-14-03.title: Singakwethemba yini ifomula esetshenziselwa ukuthola indawo ye-trapezium?
y-m-14-03.goal: Chaza ukuthi ungahlola kanjani ukuthi ifomula yendawo ayilungile, usebenzisa izimo ezikhethekile (isikwele esinde, unxantathu) noma isilinganiso (isikwele esinde esizungezile), nokuthi ungasichaza kanjani kahle lolo hlolo.
y-m-14-03.material: Kunombhede wezimbali omise okwe-trapezium. Izinhlangothi ezimbili ziyafana, uhlangothi olungaphezulu lungu-4 m, futhi uhlangothi olungezansi lungu-10 m. Ibanga (ukuphakama) phakathi kwezinhlangothi ezimbili ezifanayo lingu-4 m. Umbhede wezimbali wenziwe ngaphakathi kwesiqephu somhlaba sendingilizi esinde esingu-10 m ububanzi no-4 m ubude. U-Raon uthe indawo yalo mbhede wezimbali ingu-(uhlangothi olungaphezulu+uhlangothi olungezansi)×ukuphakama = (4+10)×4 = 56 m². Abafundi bakanye nabo bakhuluma ngezindlela zokuthola ukuthi isisho sika-Raon silungile yini.

y-m-14-03.s.s1.o.b: Qhathanisa inani elivela kule fomula nendawo yangempela uma izinhlangothi ezingaphezulu nezingezansi zilingana (isikwele esinde)
